settings.title: Import
settings.description: Bring your library over from another service.

page.title: Import media
page.description: Import from another platform, review the matches and add everything to Logged.

letterboxd.label: Letterboxd
letterboxd.description: Upload the ZIP exported by Letterboxd (Settings → Import & Export). Films are matched against TMDB.
notes: Ratings are converted from the 0.5–5 scale to Logged's 0–10.
Films are matched by title and year on TMDB; remakes or homonyms may need a manual fix.
Rewatches become separate logs for the same film.

anilist.label: AniList
anilist.description: Enter your AniList username. Public lists are read directly and matched by AniList id (anime or manga).
notes: Only public AniList profiles can be read (no login yet).
Items are matched by the AniList id, so there is no title guessing.
Watching/reading progress (episodes, chapters) is not imported.

mal.label: MyAnimeList
mal.description: Upload the .xml.gz exported by MyAnimeList. Anime or manga are matched to AniList by the MAL id.
notes: Anime/manga are matched to AniList through the MyAnimeList id.
Watched episodes / read chapters are not imported.
Plan to watch/read goes to the backlog.

goodreads.label: Goodreads
goodreads.description: Upload the CSV exported by Goodreads (My Books → Import and export → Export Library). Books are matched to OpenLibrary by ISBN.
notes: Books are matched to OpenLibrary by ISBN; books without an ISBN fall back to a title search.
The author is stored in the description, since Logged has no separate author field.
To-read goes to the backlog.

trakt.label: Trakt
trakt.description: Upload the ZIP exported by Trakt (Settings → Data → Export now). Movies and shows are matched to TMDB by the TMDB/IMDb ids in the file.
notes: Shows are imported as "in progress" — the export does not say whether you finished them.
Ratings use the 1–10 scale, imported as is.
Watchlist items go to the backlog.

imdb.label: IMDb
imdb.description: Upload your IMDb ratings.csv (Your Ratings → Export) or watchlist.csv. Movies and shows are matched to TMDB by the IMDb id.
notes: Only movies and shows are imported; episodes, games and other types are skipped.
IMDb only has the rating date, not the watch date, so the log uses the rating date.
Titles are matched to TMDB by the IMDb id (no title guessing).

grouvee.label: Grouvee
grouvee.description: Upload the CSV exported by Grouvee (Settings → "Export your collection to a CSV file"; the link arrives by email). Games are matched to IGDB by title and year.
notes: The export link is emailed to you by Grouvee — download the CSV and upload it here.
Ratings are converted from the 1–5 scale to Logged's 0–10.
Shelves: Played → finished, Playing → in progress, Backlog/Wishlist → backlog.
Games are matched to IGDB by title and year; review the matches.

infinitebacklog.label: Infinite Backlog
infinitebacklog.description: Upload the CSV exported by Infinite Backlog (Settings → export your collection). Games are matched to IGDB by title.
notes: The CSV layout is not documented, so columns are detected by their header names.
The rating scale (0–5 or 0–10) is inferred from the highest value in the file.
Games are matched to IGDB by title; review the matches.
